original.target_description: Verified Sandra and Otto (2018), Cognition 172, 101–106. The paper reports separate executive-function and Need-for-Cognition interactions, with and without reward-sensitivity adjustment, and several other tests. No assigned study, outcome, sample or test locator identifies which belongs to audit_id 2096.

replication.target_description: Verified Daniel C. Molden report for Sandra_Cognition_2018_0qar, Direct Replication, 20g, downloaded from the supplied xkwj9 URL. This is a file within the supplied w8xun project, not a node. The report distinguishes focal H* (Need for Cognition × trial type × reward on log reaction time), H1, H2, and accuracy analyses. The assignment does not identify which test is the target.

notes: Both primary full texts were acquired and their titles verified; neither paper is unavailable. Input study_o, study_r and description are null and locators_o/locators_r are empty. Requested es_type values ser_method and ser_method_t do not specify an outcome or interaction. Per the instruction for empty locators without a neutral description or study identifiers, no particular reported test was selected. The replication report identifies a focal H* but also reports other distinct hypotheses and outcomes; its prominence alone does not establish the assigned audit target. Statistics and success verdict remain unverified for this audit effect. Original DOI landing page failed, Unpaywall supplied no OA location, OpenAlex timed out; an author-hosted PDF was obtained. Replication OSF node lookup for xkwj9 returned 404 because xkwj9 is a file; w8xun file listing resolved the supplied report. No conversions or calculations performed.
